translations.web: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to Yahweh, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.
translations.bsb: You may bring them to the LORD as an offering of firstfruits, but they must not go up on the altar as a pleasing aroma.
translations.kjv: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.
translations.asv: As an oblation of first -fruits ye shall offer them unto Jehovah: but they shall not come up for a sweet savor on the altar.
